items.text: What is known about how accurately symptom checker apps assign urgency levels, compared with clinician triage, in vignette studies and in studies with real users, and for which groups is accuracy lower?
items.population: Studies of symptom checker apps used by the public
items.intervention: Urgency advice from symptom checker apps
items.comparator: Clinician or nurse triage, or vignette reference urgency
items.outcome: Correct urgency level; under-triage of emergencies; over-triage of self-care
items.time: Studies from the last ten years

finer: Feasible in 80 hours with librarian support; interesting and relevant to a pending listing decision; ethical as a review; novel in presenting vignette and real-user evidence separately for a lay committee.
summary: One broad review question in SPIDER form.
